scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.9 changes shared desktop Sync Group membership, authorization, Source ownership, import behavior, system entries, and the Electron runtime, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.9 changes shared desktop Sync Group membership, authorization, Source ownership, system entries, and Windows host acceptance behavior, so the supported Windows package is required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.9 changes shared desktop Sync Group membership, authorization, Source ownership, persistence, import behavior, system entries, and the Electron runtime, so Linux Experimental is required.
